t: You're looking at a bronze bust of Nelson Mandela, made by the sculptor Ian Walters. Mandela, often called Madiba, was an anti-apartheid revolutionary who became South Africa's first black head of state, and the first president chosen in a fully representative democratic election. He served from 1994 to 1999, and his government worked to dismantle the legacy of apartheid and to foster racial reconciliation. Ian Walters was an English sculptor, and here his portrait keeps Mandela's face present in the London streetscape.
